map.输入线性尺寸链中各环节的公差，工具用均方根（RSS）法估计装配后的统计总公差，相: Enter the tolerances of each link in a linear dimension chain. The tool estimates the statistical total tolerance after assembly with the root-sum-square (RSS) method, which reflects real high-volume production variation better than the worst-case method, supporting tolerance allocation and assemblability assessment.

map.用均方根法估计线性尺寸链的统计总公差。: Estimates the statistical total tolerance of a linear dimension chain with the root-sum-square method.
map.尺寸链/装配间隙分析中，用方和根（Root Sum Square）估算多个零件公: In dimension-chain and assembly-clearance analysis, the root sum square estimates the total variation when several part tolerances stack up, which is closer to statistical reality than the worst case.
map.大批量生产下各零件误差近似独立随机分布，RSS 给出『典型』总公差而非极端值。: In high-volume production part errors are roughly independent random variables, so RSS gives a typical total tolerance rather than an extreme value.
map.在保证装配功能前提下，用 RSS 放宽容差以降本，而非一味按最坏情况加严。: Where assembly function is guaranteed, use RSS to relax tolerances and cut cost instead of tightening everything to the worst case.
map.：总公差 T = √(t₁² + t₂² + … + tₙ²)，各 tᵢ 为各组: Total tolerance T = √(t₁² + t₂² + … + tₙ²), where each tᵢ is the tolerance of one component link (take absolute values when they stack in the same direction). RSS assumes the errors are independent and approximately normal, giving the typical total variation at about 99.73% confidence (±3σ).
map.：某装配尺寸链由三段组成，各段公差分别为 0.1、0.15、0.2 mm：T =: An assembly dimension chain of three links has tolerances 0.1, 0.15 and 0.2 mm: T = √(0.1² + 0.15² + 0.2²) = √(0.01 + 0.0225 + 0.04) = √0.0725 ≈ 0.269 mm (RSS). This is far smaller than the 0.45 mm worst-case stack, showing that individual tolerances can be relaxed somewhat in high volume without producing out-of-spec parts.
map.RSS 和最坏情况（WC）怎么选？: How to choose between RSS and worst case (WC)?
map.WC 假设所有误差同时取极值同向叠加，给出绝对安全但过严的总公差；RSS 假设独: WC assumes all errors simultaneously take extreme values in the same direction, giving an absolutely safe but overly tight total tolerance, while RSS assumes independent random errors and gives a typical value. Use WC for one-off, small-batch or safety-critical parts; RSS is more economical under high-volume statistical process control.
map.RSS 的前提是什么？: What are the prerequisites for RSS?
map.要求各组成误差相互独立、且分布近似正态（或至少对称）；若存在系统性偏差（如刀具统: The component errors must be mutually independent and approximately normal (or at least symmetric). If a systematic bias exists, such as a tool that is consistently oversize, treat it as an offset rather than a random tolerance, otherwise RSS underestimates the true total error.
